text: Five GTA 6 facts most players don't know.
One: its first trailer hit ninety million YouTube views in a single day.
Two: it arrives thirteen years after GTA 5.
Three: GTA 5 has sold over two hundred thirty million copies.
Four: Vice City is back, in Leonida, a fictional Florida.
Five: in 2022, about ninety clips leaked.
The hacker? A teenager on bail, in a hotel room, using a TV streaming stick.
